summary: Earth to Space identifies places on Earth with conditions similar to the Moon and Mars, helping research and plan future space bases.
details: The Earth to Space project is an interactive educational website developed using HTML, designed to identify terrestrial locations with environmental conditions similar to those found on the Moon and Mars. The website features an interactive world map, scientific comparisons, space exploration news, and a research timeline. Its main benefit is helping researchers and space enthusiasts discover potential locations for testing technologies and planning future space bases. The project's creative aspect is connecting real places on Earth to space exploration through accessible and visual information. The team considered important factors such as temperature, soil composition, terrain, and environmental conditions to identify the most suitable locations.
